historical_record.description: A three-story commercial building stood at the property, formerly a television station and most recently a tennis club.

The City Planning Commission approved a conditional use authorization to demolish an existing three-story commercial building and construct a new six-story, mixed-use building of up to 29 dwelling units, 43 parking spaces and approximately 4,700 square feet of commercial space, exceeding 40 feet in height and the prescribed bulk limit, as amended.
